timestamp_treatment: HF/Massive-STEPS timestamps are naive datetimes with timezone offset stripped. Local mode: tz_localize('UTC') then tz_convert(IANA city zone).
data_policy: Complete published city CSVs from HF (train+val+test as published). Fit on official train only; eval on official test only. No city/row subsample except documented long-tail user filter for the filtered Acc table.
WorkWeekendMostPop: Work = Mon–Fri (weekday < 5); Weekend = Sat–Sun; keyed on target local (or utc) workweekend
prediction_time: timestamp of the check-in being predicted (event time known). On next-POI trail eval: target venue = last check-in's venue_id; prediction time = that same last check-in's timestamp (city IANA local). Never use the trail's first check-in time.
eval_split: official HF train/test only (user-disjoint removed from this protocol)
UserMostPop_Day: Per-user MostPop over that user's train check-ins with local hour in [7,19); at test, use target check-in local daynight==day. Fallback: user global UserMostPop, then global MostPop.
UserMostPop_Night: Same as UserMostPop_Day but night bin (hour not in [7,19)).
UserMostPop_DayNight: Router: pick Day or Night user-bin from target local (or utc) daynight.
UserMostPop_Weekday: Per-user MostPop over train check-ins matching target weekday; fallback user-global then MostPop.
UserMostPop_WorkWeekend: Per-user MostPop over train check-ins in matching Work (Mon–Fri) or Weekend (Sat–Sun) bin from target local time; fallback user-global then MostPop. Addresses sparse 7-way UMP_Weekday.

longtail_filter.requirements: >= 5 train check-ins AND >= 2 in each of {day, night} AND >= 2 in each of {work, weekend} (local time bins on train)
